arguments.query: select name, sql from sqlite_master where type="table"

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.amount_cents,b.client_reference,(select group_concat(c.state||":"||c.idempotency_key,";") from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select group_concat(state) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id) ob from bookings b

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.amount_cents,b.client_reference,(select group_concat(c.state||":"||c.idempotency_key,";") from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select group_concat(status) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id) ob from bookings b

select b.booking_id,b.status,(select group_concat(c.state,";") from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select group_concat(status||o.attempts) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id) ob,(select group_concat(final_state||settles_at_step||state) from provider_ledger p where p.booking_id=b.booking_id) pl,(select step from episode_clock) st from bookings b where b.status!="confirmed" or b.booking_id not in (select booking_id from checkins)

select b.booking_id,b.status,(select group_concat(c.state,";") from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select group_concat(status||o.attempts) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id) ob,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) ck from bookings b where b.status!="confirmed" or ck=0 or ob is null

select o.event_id,o.booking_id,o.status,o.attempts,o.payload from outbox o where o.status!="delivered" union all select "ck",count(*),"",0,"" from checkins union all select "bk",status,"",count(*),"" from bookings group by status
select service,status,count(*) n,max(message) m from request_logs where id>(select max(id)-60 from request_logs) group by service,status

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,(select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) nc,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) ck,(select group_concat(status) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id) ob from bookings b where b.status="pending" or nc!=1 or ck=0

select "ev" k,request_id a,kind b,step c from customer_events union all select "orph",charge_id,booking_id,state from charges where booking_id not in (select booking_id from bookings) union all select "ref",booking_id,status,amount_cents from refunds join bookings using(booking_id) union all select "fh",flight_id,price_cents,until_step from fare_holds union all select "fl",flight_id,price_cents,capacity from flights union all select "cache",key,value,0 from cache union all select "bad",booking_id,status,0 from bookings b where status="confirmed" and (select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and state="captured")!=1

select "ev" k,request_id a,kind b,step c from customer_events union all select "orph",charge_id,booking_id,state from charges where booking_id not in (select booking_id from bookings) union all select "ref",booking_id,charge_id,amount_cents from refunds union all select "fh",flight_id,price_cents,until_step from fare_holds union all select "fl",flight_id,price_cents,capacity from flights union all select "cache",key,value,0 from cache union all select "bad",booking_id,status,0 from bookings b where status="confirmed" and (select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and state="captured")!=1

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.request_id,(select count(*) from customer_events e where e.request_id=b.request_id) ev, (select group_concat(state) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select count(*) from refunds r where r.booking_id=b.booking_id) rf from bookings b where ev>0 or status="cancelled"
